# Sheldon Roth Fine Art

> Limited-edition fine art photography by Sheldon Roth — nature, wildlife, underwater and landscape photographs, printed as archival Lumachrome HD prints and face-mounted to TruLife museum-grade acrylic.

Sheldon Roth is a fine art nature, wildlife and underwater photographer. His work ranges from high peaks, glaciers and alpine lakes to reefs, coastlines, wildlife portraits and panoramas. Each photograph is a single moment from the field, released as a signed and numbered limited edition with a certificate of authenticity.

Prints are archival Lumachrome HD prints, face-mounted to TruLife anti-reflective museum-grade acrylic, with an acrylic backing, a floating mount and a French-cleat hanger. A size is only offered when the original file holds at least 150 pixels per inch at that size. Online checkout ships free within the United States (insured, signature required). International delivery is by studio inquiry. Every piece is made to order; please allow 2–4 weeks from order to delivery.

## Editions and pricing

Each work is one edition shared across all of its sizes. Prices follow a published five-step ladder: the first quarter of an edition is offered at the opening price, then the price rises by 20%, 40% and 70% as the edition sells. The final 10% of each edition (at twice the opening price) is offered by inquiry. Artist Proofs, where they exist, are a separately numbered run of the largest available size, offered by inquiry at the top of the ladder from the outset.

- Premier — edition of 20, plus 2 Artist Proofs, from $4,800. The five defining works: [Premier Works](https://sheldonroth.com/premier).
- Signature — edition of 40, plus 4 Artist Proofs, from $3,400. See [Signature Works](https://sheldonroth.com/collections/signature).
- Collection — edition of 75, from $1,650 (no Artist Proofs).

Opening prices are by size and tier. Collection works begin at 24 × 16 in; Premier and Signature works begin at 30 × 20 in. Larger sizes (36 × 24, 45 × 30, 60 × 40, and 2:1 panoramic sizes such as 36 × 18 in) are offered when the master file supports them.

## Returns

Collectors may contact the studio within 14 days of delivery to return a work in its original crate and packaging, insured, with return freight paid by the collector. Once the piece arrives back undamaged, the collector may choose a full refund of the purchase price or a full exchange credit toward another work. Damage in transit is replaced at no cost if reported within 48 hours with photographs.
